title: Log in
intro: We will send a login code to your email.
codeIntro: If {{email}} has access, we sent a 6-digit code to it. It is valid for 5 minutes.

errors.wrongCode: The code is not correct. Attempts left: {{count}}.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.disabled: This account no longer has access.

linkExpired: The link has expired. Sign in with your email.

invite.about: Help is where you work with the eGrant team: chat, tasks, support tickets and shared documents in one place.

passkey.hint: For admins who added a passkey in Settings.
passkey.invalid: This passkey cannot be used. Log in with an email code.
passkey.failed: Logging in with the passkey failed. Try again, or log in with an email code.
